name: Revitalizing Cleanse recovers damage based on water cards in memory and draws a card
notes: Revitalizing Cleanse's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water) to unlock element access. The champion is pre-patched with 5 damage so the recover effect is observable, and two WATER-element cards (Water Barrier, Tsunami of Nanyue) are seeded directly into memory. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 5-reserve cost is paid; paying reserve moves the spent hand cards into memory too, and the observed result (all 5 damage recovered) shows the water-card count at resolution time was at least 5, not just the 2 deliberately seeded -- RecoverChampion caps at 0 rather than going negative, so this fixture verifies recovery happened and the champion ends undamaged, without asserting an exact X value.

rulesClauses: Reveal all cards in your memory. Recover X where X is the amount of water element cards revealed this way. Draw a card.
